packageRules.description: semgrep ships wheels for CPython 3.10-3.14 only; its pinned ruamel.yaml.clib has no cp315 wheel, so the Scan PHP job cannot install on 3.15. Lift once semgrep supports 3.15.
Stay on the MariaDB 12.3 LTS line (supported until 2029-06-12) instead of the rolling 13.x releases. Patch and digest updates of 12.3 still arrive. Raise this when the next LTS line is out.
